ewasoCampDiscrepancy.confidenceNote: UNRESOLVED CONFLICT between two source documents for the same property, both on file in the same HODARI AFRICA folder. This 2026 collection PDF states Ewaso Camp Non-Resident Full Board Low/High sharing at $160/$200. A separate standalone file, 'Ewaso Camp Rates 2025-26.pdf' (same folder), states Non-Resident Full Board rates as: Low season (1 Mar-31 May) RACK sharing $220 / CONTRACT sharing $200; High season (1 Jun-28/29 Feb) RACK sharing $250 / CONTRACT sharing $235. Neither the Rack nor Contract figures in the standalone file match this collection doc's $160/$200 sharing figures, and even the two files' season date windows differ (this doc: low=Mar-Jun+Nov-mid Dec, high=mid Dec-Oct; standalone file: low=Mar-May, high=Jun-Feb). Also note the standalone file's child bracket is 3-11 years vs this doc's 5-12 years, and its conservation fee/game drive/activity figures differ slightly ($75pp is consistent, but game drives $200/car vs 'on request' here, activities $25pp vs $35pp here). Do not average or default to either source - confirm current 2026 Ewaso Camp rates directly with Hodari Africa/Ewaso Camp before quoting.
